summary: ITER 106 verification: Fix #3 maklon invoice cancel/regenerate path, LOW #3 maklon PO auto-numbering, iter105 regression suite, and Maklon UI/portal regression. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter106_maklon.py (18 tests incl. DB-level assertions via pymongo) = 18/18 pass; tests/test_iter105_maklon.py = 46/46 pass (64 total). All requested backend assertions matched exactly (eligible row 60/150 Rp720.000 INV-MKL-2026-0001; generate total 799200 / qty 60 / status issued; duplicate generate 400 'sudah memiliki invoice'; 360 invoiced_amount 799200; payment 100000 -> partial_paid and unpay -> issued; cancel returns ar_status draft, mirror doc DELETED, AR reverted to draft with amount_paid 0 / issued_at null / same id+number exactly once, PO back to partial_delivered with ar_invoice_number unchanged; regenerate reuses same id+number without DuplicateKeyError/500; cleanup sync returns mirror_status partial_delivered). Auto-numbering verified: policy mode auto + format PO-MKL-{YYYY}{MM}-{SEQ:4}, POST without po_number -> PO-MKL-202609-0006 (matches ^PO-MKL-\d{6}-\d{4}$), manual number rejected 400 with 'OTOMATIS', maklon-finance mirror confirmed/200000/CMT 120000/margin 80000/AR draft unit_price 20000, DELETE cascades mirror+AR+404. Extra edge cases added: cancel blocked (400) while fully paid without deleting mirror, overpayment blocked, cancel of unknown/already-cancelled id returns 404 (no 500), generate with custom invoice_number rejected pointing at AR number and no mirror created. UI: maklon-billing generate dialog lists 'PO-MK-DEMO-2 — PT Aruna Activewear · terkirim 60/150 pcs · Rp 720.000', engine-AR note mentions INV-MKL-2026-0001, no 'Nomor Invoice' field after selection; maklon-po-360 and maklon-dashboard render with zero console errors; PO Maklon 'Buat PO' shows disabled data-testid=po-number-auto (PO-MKL-202609-0007) with 'otomatis' hint. Portals: vendor (cmtvendor) dashboard/jobs/shipments/receipts render, no 4xx and no 403 toasts; klien portal shows only PT Aruna POs (PO-MK-DEMO-1, PO-MK-DEMO-2 67%). Final DB state left clean: po-mk-demo-2 uninvoiced (no dewi mirror, AR draft, mirror status partial_delivered), no test POs/payments left.

rca_of_the_issue: Iter105 blocker was caused by the cancel path keeping the mirror doc in dewi_maklon_invoices as 'cancelled' with the same id/invoice_number as the AR, so re-generate hit the unique index on invoice_number (DuplicateKeyError -> 500). Fix verified: engine_ar cancel now deletes the mirror + its payments and reverts the AR to draft (amount_paid 0, issued_at null), while generate additionally purges legacy cancelled mirrors and upserts by id — regenerate now returns the same id/number with no duplicates in either collection.
